title: It was fun! I went out to her garden.
scene: 回家被问今天怎么样，讲奶奶的菜园。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It was fun! I went out to her garden.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Ooh, what did you see out there?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Tomatoes! The whole garden was red!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I picked the biggest one, and I went to show Grandma.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She hugged me and called it a super tomato!
